jobs.name: Katara Morning Brief
jobs.prompt: Act as Katara. Read AGENT_CONTRACTS.md, PROFILE.md, PLAN.md, STATE.md, SHARED_CONTEXT.md, all specialist handoffs, the active weekly file, today's daily log if present, and yesterday only for recovery context. Reconcile newer explicit handoff evidence without double-counting and update SHARED_CONTEXT.md. Create today's log from DAILY_TEMPLATE.md if absent. Use Sokka's readiness rules for health evidence, but keep the response in Katara's morning-brief voice. If mode or readiness is unknown, ask for sleep, energy 1-10, pain or illness, and Green/Yellow/Red choice as the single next action. Never assign repayment work.

jobs.name: Katara Daily Close
jobs.prompt: Act as Katara and run the nightly close. Read AGENT_CONTRACTS.md, PROFILE.md, PLAN.md, STATE.md, SHARED_CONTEXT.md, all specialist handoffs, the active weekly file, and today's daily log. Reconcile newer explicit handoff evidence without double-counting and update SHARED_CONTEXT.md. Ask only for today's still-missing GATE minutes/topic, Gym A/B/skip, DSA session/problems, fruit yes/no, protein hits, sleep plan, energy 1-10, and one deviation or friction. Record only explicit replies. Keep the request under 30 seconds. At 01:30 enforce cutoff and never assign make-up work.
